proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The ambient groupoid (U, U times_S U, pr_1, pr_0, pr_02) makes the statement a special case of the map-groupoids perfect-field version; a direct proof is also given, starting by explaining why the statement makes sense. Over a perfect field k the reduced closed subscheme Z is geometrically reduced over k via either projection (varieties perfect-reduced lemma), hence the fibre product Z times over pr_1 and pr_0 of Z inside Z times itself is reduced (varieties geometrically-reduced-any-base-change lemma). By the groupoid-on-field-image lemma the set theoretic containment pr_02(Z times Z) inside Z upgrades to an induced morphism Z times_{pr_1, U, pr_0} Z to Z. It is immediate from the groupoid identities that the diagonal of U over S factors through Z (j composed with e is the diagonal) and that the flip sigma preserves Z (sigma composed with j is j composed with the inverse); since the ambient septuple satisfies the groupoid axioms, restricting all structure maps to Z preserves them, so (U, Z, pr_0|_Z, pr_1|_Z, pr_02 restricted) is a groupoid scheme over S. (source lines 1942-1968)

core_obligations: Legitimacy of the statement and the composition morphism: U = Spec(k) with k perfect makes Z geometrically reduced over k via either projection (varieties-lemma-perfect-reduced); hence Z times_{pr_1, U, pr_0} Z, a subscheme of Z times Z, is reduced (varieties-lemma-geometrically-reduced-any-base-change); by lemma-groupoid-on-field-image pr_02(Z times Z) lies in Z set theoretically, so pr_02 induces a morphism Z times_{pr_1, U, pr_0} Z to Z (proof lines 1949-1959). Remaining structure: the diagonal of U over S factors through Z because j composed with e gives the diagonal, and the flip sigma preserves Z because sigma composed with j is j composed with the inverse of the groupoid; since (U, U times_S U, pr_0, pr_1, pr_02, Delta, sigma) satisfies the groupoid axioms, restricting to the invariant subscheme Z preserves all axioms, so (U, Z, pr_0|_Z, pr_1|_Z, pr_02 restricted) is a groupoid scheme over S (proof lines 1960-1967).
proof_roadmap: Note the special-case route through the map-groupoids perfect-field version (proof lines 1943-1946).
Build the reducedness chain: geometric reduction over the perfect field, then reducedness of the restricted fibre product (proof lines 1949-1955).
Upgrade the set theoretic containment of the field-image lemma to the induced composition morphism into Z (proof lines 1956-1959).
Verify the remaining groupoid data (diagonal, flip) and restrict the ambient axioms to Z (proof lines 1960-1967).
